mechanism: Scheduled macro releases are the one class of FX risk whose timing is common knowledge and exogenously fixed. The forced actors are inventory-constrained dealers and gap-risk-sensitive leveraged accounts: into a known release instant, holders of extended directional positions reduce exposure regardless of view, because a print resolves systematic risk with a jump that position limits and margin models treat asymmetrically (documented pre-announcement positioning/term-structure effects: Lucca & Moench 2015 JF; Savor & Wilson 2014 JME; forced-deleveraging propagation: Brunnermeier & Pedersen 2009 RF; order flow as the transmission of positioning: Evans & Lyons 2002 JF; microstructure price formation around scheduled public information: Fleming & Remolona 1999 JF). The mechanism under test is the PRE-RELEASE window, not the post-release reaction: if position-avoidance into evidenced scheduled risk is real, the pair's trailing multi-day extension partially UNWINDS between the second-to-last and first completed daily bars around the evidenced release instant — a counter-trend drift that exists BEFORE availability and is silent about the print's outcome. Quantitative law, frozen. Conditioning objects are the 246 evidenced clocks of p3_conditioning_clocks_v5.json, restricted to the 4 economies with evidenced per-print availability (GB/CA/AU/NZ); each clock c = (economy E, available_time_utc a) maps to the unique authorized pair P(E): GB->GBP/USD, CA->USD/CAD, AU->AUD/USD, NZ->NZD/USD. For each clock: F = the last completed 16:00 America/New_York bar of P(E) strictly before a; D = the completed 16:00-NY bar of the previous valid session strictly before F (decision bar); X = the first completed 16:00-NY bar strictly after a. At D compute x = the sum of the 10 most recent daily log returns of P(E) over completed 16:00-NY closes strictly before D; direction = -sign(x) (exact zero -> NO_TRADE, fail-closed). If flat and the governor allows, enter at F and exit at X — the holding window [F, X] spans the evidenced release instant a by construction (F < a < X), holds no post-release session beyond X, and never reads the print's value. Who is forced to act: dealers re-centering inventory and leveraged holders cutting gap exposure into a known jump risk; why observable: the evidenced clocks pin a ex ante (the release schedule is public ahead of time); when it must fail: if scheduled-release days show no differential counter-trend drift versus other days, the anchor earns nothing but cost — the falsification is live, not decorative.
falsifiable_prediction: (i) The release-spanning window [F, X] earns positive after-cost financing-adjusted expectancy in the counter-trend direction across the 4 evidenced-economy pairs, with the price-only book not inverting the anchor expectancy sign; (ii) incremental alpha versus the stale-calendar benchmark (identical law anchored to each economy's PREVIOUS evidenced clock) is strictly > 0 — release-proximity information, not monthly-calendar position alone, must carry the value; (iii) the sham-calendar causal control (identical reversal law, clocks/costs/holds, anchors shifted +7 calendar days to windows containing no evidenced release) must NOT reproduce the edge under its preregistered rule — if it fires, generic multi-day reversal and not the evidenced release calendar is the operative ingredient and the family fails regardless of the anchor's sign; (iv) all inherited Stage-A gates pass with the tier-2.0 stress book as a primary gate.

universe.subset_justification: Causal and evidence-causal, decided ex ante: a pair is tradable in this family iff its non-USD leg's economy has evidenced per-print CPI availability (GB 88 / CA 105 / AU 23 / NZ 30 clocks). EUR/USD, USD/JPY and USD/CHF are excluded because the US bloc is UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED (BLS anti-bot 403, archived), JP is FORWARD_SCHEDULE_ONLY and CH/EMU are UNEVIDENCED / DATA_YES_TIMING_NO per p0_verdict.json — an evidence-driven exclusion, not a result-aware subset (no outcome exists).

decision_clock: DAILY: one decision per pair per NY trading day at the completion instant of the 16:00 America/New_York flat bar (20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST via zoneinfo; DST-aware, never fixed offsets; DST 16:00-NY calendar invariants inherited per p2_data_authority_v5.json calendar block). Session gate Sun 21:00 America/New_York -> Fri 16:00 New York; no weekend decisions or fills. Daily-or-slower satisfied; no intraday decision anywhere.
warmup: 11 completed valid NY-days of 16:00-NY closes for the traded pair strictly before the decision bar (10-day return sum needs 11 closes); a NY-day is valid only if that day's completed bar exists — missing bars void the clock (NO_EVAL, fail-closed, never fill-forward). Clocks whose F or X does not exist inside the snapshot, or whose X would fall after the S0 cap (entry instant must be < 2025-07-25T00:00:00Z per the S0 window of the clocks authority), are excluded and counted (s0_cap_excluded).
features_and_lags: Price features: only completed 16:00-NY bars strictly before the decision instant (a completed bar is available at its completion instant by construction; no stamp needed — availability-lagged trivially). Calendar feature: the evidenced clock's available_time_utc must lie strictly INSIDE the holding window (mechanically enforced F < a < X) — the position is held INTO availability, and no feature computed anywhere uses data with available_time > its computation instant. The print's VALUE is never read (clock rows carry timing evidence only; value-like conditioning is out of scope for this family). Disclosed limitation: the operative real-time object is the published forward release schedule; the backtest keys windows to the evidenced realized stamps and assumes schedule/realized coincidence — flagged for D2 feasibility quantification (both arms share the property, so slippage noise hits anchor and control symmetrically).
entry_rules: On clock c with decision bar D: direction = -sign(trailing 10-NY-day return sum at D); if |direction| trade and the pair is flat, enter at the open of bar F (the last completed 16:00-NY bar strictly before a; exactly one session after D — one-event lag). Governor: max 1 position per pair, max 1 entry per pair per NY-day; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred.
exit_rules: Exit at the open of bar X (first completed 16:00-NY bar strictly after a). No profit target, no stop, no time extension, no signal refresh while a position is open. Force-flat: a window that would cross an internal fold boundary exits at the last completed 16:00-NY bar before the boundary (force_flat=true, kernel-attributed); a trade spanning a boundary is refused (FOLD_FORCE_FLAT_VIOLATION). Missing entry/exit bar => clock voided or earliest-scheduled exit, never fill-forward.
fill_convention: One-event lag: decision at completed bar D, fill at the next session's 16:00-NY bar F, never same-bar (ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION inherited); a fill gap exceeding 4 calendar days over holiday weekends fails closed to NO_TRADE (inherited 4-day next-session validator constraint). Fill prices are the fill bar's open; DST-aware bar stamps 20:00Z/21:00Z.

anchor.spec: Exactly the frozen mechanism law: 246 evidenced clocks, 4 evidenced-economy pairs, release-spanning windows [F, X], direction = -sign(trailing 10-NY-day return sum at D), entry at F, exit at X, governor, force-flat folds, dual book.

neighbour.one_presumption_away: Swaps only the extension-measurement presumption (a 10-NY-day trailing sum captures 'the positioning that is unwound into the event') for a 5-NY-day trailing sum — the same presumption at the shorter positioning horizon. If the mechanism is real, the neighbour moves TOGETHER with the anchor (same verdict sign, similar fold pattern); divergence means the signal sits on a knife-edge between positioning horizons and the family is not promotable.
neighbour.spec: Byte-identical to anchor EXCEPT the trailing sum is 5 NY-days; same clocks, windows, clocks->pair map, governor, folds, costs, dual book.

control.role: Sham-calendar causal control: destroys exactly the operative ingredient — the evidenced release timing — while holding the reversal law, pair map, clock, holds, costs, governor and dual book identical. Each evidenced clock is shifted +7 calendar days (same time-of-day availability stamp); a shifted anchor is VALID iff no evidenced clock of ANY of the 4 evidenced economies falls strictly inside the resulting sham holding window (checked against p3_conditioning_clocks_v5.json; invalid anchors are dropped fail-closed and counted as sham_dropped). The sham windows therefore contain no release, and the book is otherwise byte-identical to the anchor.
control.disclosed_leakage: Day-of-week composition is preserved by the +7 shift, but month-of-year placement of individual windows moves slightly; the stale-calendar benchmark (not this control) is the preregistered test of calendar-position seasonality. The control is NOT a claim that reversal does not exist — it is the preregistered test of whether EVIDENCED-RELEASE-TIMING information, rather than generic multi-day reversal, is the operative ingredient.
control.runs_to_completion: Yes: price-only law on the same pairs and bars; every sham anchor has an observable; the book executes under evidenced semantics with the same fail-closed rules as the anchor (the V3R lesson — a control that cannot execute has null evidentiary value — is respected; no ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION-by-construction arm).
control.preregistered_non_reproduction_rule: The control REPRODUCES (and the family FAILS its control gate regardless of the anchor's sign) if control financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND control PF >= 1.10, OR control expectancy >= 0.5 x anchor expectancy. Positive raw control PnL never overrides a firing control; the kernel's mechanism_sanity definition governs where its label differs from this prose.

incremental_test.benchmark_definition: Per the frozen benchmark_treatment convention (freshness removed, everything else identical): the anchor law with every trade anchored to the SAME economy's PREVIOUS evidenced clock (c_prev) — decision, fill and exit instants all derived from c_prev's window with directions computed at the c_prev-anchored decision bar. A stale trade still spans a real release (the previous cycle's), but carries no fresh release-proximity content. First clock per economy has no predecessor and is skipped (counted).
incremental_test.gate: Overall incremental alpha > 0: anchor financing-adjusted expectancy minus benchmark financing-adjusted expectancy, evaluated under the same gates as the anchor. Positive raw anchor PnL never overrides a failed incremental alpha. The benchmark is an auxiliary treatment inside the anchor cell, not a fourth scored arm.

costs.application: F1-FIXED: tier multipliers applied to BOOKED stress PnL through the inherited P1 accounting kernel; base / tier-1.5 / tier-2.0 rows pairwise distinct when trades are non-empty (STRESS_ROWS_NOT_DISTINCT fail-closed). Tier 2.0 is a PRIMARY Stage-A gate, not an appendix.
costs.delay_stress: Frozen one-session delay (entry and exit each shifted one additional 16:00-NY bar) carried as a SEPARATE fill_delay_events component, never blended into the cost tiers.
costs.break_even_reporting: break_even_bps_per_fill reported full-sample and per fold from the same cost kernel; a cell whose break-even sits below the tier bps fails for cost reasons rather than absence of gross edge — diagnostic, never a fee rescue.

drop_one_design.procedure: This family trades 4 of the 7 authorized pairs (evidence-driven), so the kernel's 7-pair 8-scenario dropout is adapted family-side as in V4: 4 pair+calendar drops (drop GBP/USD with all GB clocks; USD/CAD with CA; AUD/USD with AU; NZD/USD with NZ — each renormalizes the book to 3 pairs with the frozen law unchanged) + the inherited drop-one-BEST-fold = 5 scenarios.
drop_one_design.gate: Anchor financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.00 in at least 4 of 5 scenarios (proportional tightening of the inherited 6/8 rule to the 5-scenario design; the kernel's DROPOUT definition governs where labels differ).
drop_one_design.non_vacuity: Each pair+calendar drop removes that economy's entire clock set and pair, changing the book by construction (GB 88 / CA 105 / AU 23 / NZ 30 clocks); asserted at implementation as a test.
drop_one_design.interpretation: Failure means the edge is a single-economy artifact (e.g. one country's episode), not a cross-economy position-avoidance mechanism.

governor.enforcement: Deterministic and PIT-safe; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred.

dual_book_and_financing.mandate: Every scored cell books BOTH price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate immutable digest-covered columns, all arms (inherited kernel).
dual_book_and_financing.financing_formula_frozen_verbatim: financing_adjusted_pnl = price_only_pnl + sign * notional_usd * (r_base - r_quote) * holding_days/365, accrued per calendar day at the day-start as-of policy-rate differential from the evidenced policy-rate vintages of the pinned V5-extension announcement ledger (sha256 cf1f01a7ec2d3d7506892c045139910937147df49d3742cc4ec72b36d20fd902; rows eligible only when available_time_utc <= the accrual instant; never eligible on their own effective date).
dual_book_and_financing.disclosed_approximation: Policy rates are unsecured official rates, NOT swap/OIS-implied rollover; disclosed ex ante per inherited convention (HISTORICAL_ROLLOVER_FINANCING UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED).
dual_book_and_financing.financing_gate: The financing term must not manufacture the edge: the price-only book must not invert the sign of the anchor's expectancy (FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE inherited gate). This family is calendar/price-only in its signal.

falsification_rule: The family FAILS (terminal, no post-observation tuning of clocks, horizons, sums, windows, legs or clocks) if ANY of: (i) anchor financing-adjusted expectancy <= 0, or PF < 1.10, or any inherited Stage-A gate fails (margin-to-fail recorded per gate, P-2); (ii) CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM: control fin-adj expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.10, OR control expectancy >= 0.5 x anchor expectancy — generic multi-day reversal, not release timing, explains the book; (iii) incremental alpha <= 0 vs the stale-calendar benchmark — monthly-calendar position, not release proximity, explains the book; (iv) NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR per kernel mechanism_sanity; (v) any MDD / fold-population / concentration / dropout / USD-drift / stress-tier-2.0 / financing gate failure.
failure_interpretation: Negative anchor expectancy after base cost: evidenced release instants carry no after-cost pre-release counter-trend edge at the frozen cost authority — a complete, publishable reject with break-even bps attributing cost vs gross absence; no sign inversion, no window/horizon rescue, no economy subset, no lower cost, no re-clocking. Anchor positive but the sham-calendar control fires: the edge is generic multi-day reversal (the E.2 exposure-form class) and the release-calendar information source is not operative — reject regardless of anchor sign. Anchor positive but incremental alpha <= 0: month-position seasonality, not release proximity — reject. Anchor positive on financing-adjusted but price-only inverts the expectancy sign: financing artifact — reject. Neighbour diverges: knife-edge between positioning horizons — not promotable. Drop-one failure: single-economy artifact — reject. Realized turnover below the 140-trade floor: INDETERMINATE (never negative evidence); unused slots are never reassigned.

(6) V3 family2 (FXFV3-A6-P1, realized-vol-gated policy-rate-differential carry, DATA_AUTHORITY_INVALIDATED) and the CLOSED carry region (V4-measured rho 0.997-1.000) — no policy-rate differential in any signal role, no realized-vol state gate, no differential-direction holding law, no financing-dependent direction; this packet does NOT invoke the Section 1.1 front door. Traded legs partially overlap (AUD/NZD/CAD are evidenced-economy pairs) — disclosed, and the decision-schedule rho vs FXFV4-A6-P1 (both scored variants) is submitted to the |rho| <= 0.20 A7-N bar for D2 to measure, not argue. Blanket clauses: no cost assumptions below the frozen 1.5 bps x {1.0,1.5,2.0} authority; no pair cherry-picking (the 4-pair set is fixed by evidence availability ex ante); no result-aware reuse of any earlier packet; no re-grading of any prior cell. E.2 shadow effects (inverted-OI-flow, plain vol-level sorting, sector-exposure form) are crypto/stocks phenomena and are not reused in any role.
control_identifiability_statement: Why a generic exposure form CANNOT silently reproduce this family's claim: the sham-calendar control retains the entire trading law (multi-day counter-trend reversal, same pairs, same session distribution, same costs and holds) and removes ONLY the evidenced release timing. If the anchor's PnL is produced by plain reversal exposure, the control reproduces it on non-release windows and CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM fires — the exact V2-family2 failure mode is the preregistered death, not an unanticipated one. Conversely no control can rescue the anchor: the control never validates, it only falsifies.

margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0: If position-avoidance drift exists, expected fin-adj expectancy +2 to +20 per 10k-unit trade over 1-2 session holds; honest prior is wide — a genuine reject is a live outcome. Knife-edge risk MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.pf_ge_110: Expected 1.00-1.20 if real; historically the thinnest gate class. Knife-edge risk HIGH.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_of_3: Clocks are spread across 2018-2025 with no single stress cluster dominating; expected 2/3 positive if real. Fold-population margin est. 1.6-2.3x the 30-trade floor — MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.mdd_within_frozen_ceiling: 1-2 session holds on 10k units; est. 300-1200 USD vs the 2500 ceiling. LOW-MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_tier_2_0_primary: Gross per-trade must clear 6 bps RT; expected gross 8-40 bps IF the effect exists (1-2 session windows are small-move windows) — headroom THIN by construction; this is the most likely single-gate failure. Knife-edge risk HIGH.
margin_to_fail_expectations.fold_positive_share_and_concentration: PAIR_CONCENTRATION_ABOVE_40PCT is a declared HIGH structural risk: CA holds ~43% of clocks (105/246) and GB ~36% — if CA's trades carry > 40% of gross positive PnL the gate fails; no cherry-picking remedy is permitted. Kernel label definitions govern. Knife-edge HIGH.
margin_to_fail_expectations.usd_drift_gate: Single-pair, both-direction, calendar-driven book; expected |corr| 0.05-0.20 vs 0.30 ceiling. LOW-MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.incremental_alpha_gt_0: The stale anchor shares month-position seasonality with the anchor by construction, so the gate isolates proximity specifically; expected margin a large fraction of anchor expectancy IF proximity is real. Residual risk: if the effect is actually monthly-seasonality, alpha <= 0 and the family dies — by design. THIN-POSITIVE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_non_reproduction: The +7-day shift preserves the reversal law, so this control is a genuine falsification risk BY DESIGN: if plain multi-day reversal exists on these pairs, the control fires. Expected outcome: fires iff the calendar claim is wrong. MODERATE-HIGH risk — intended.
margin_to_fail_expectations.sample_floor: Trades margin est. 1.2-1.4x the 140 floor — THIN, INDETERMINATE-by-rule risk declared; decisions margin ~5x.
margin_to_fail_expectations.overall_prior: Conditional on the effect existing, the most likely failing gates are tier-2.0 stress (small-window gross edge vs 6 bps) and pair concentration (CA clock share); conditional on it not existing, expectancy fails outright.
